text:
Ivy Tran: FYI — CedarBridge Labs is asking to list cedarbridge-9b-open in our Marketplace and wants an approved SI bundle with Meridian Tech. They specifically want us to be able to ship q4 quantized weights to Meridian for offline installs. Can we scope legal + ops constraints?

Noah Becker: From Marketplace side we need the SPDX license text, model-card, weights checksum, and a short perf blurb. Important: if we distribute converted artifacts we must include provenance headers and a signature.

Sana Mirza: Legal quick check — open license looks permissive but model-card references CC-BY subsets. I need the exact license file from CedarBridge. If they permit distribution of derived artifacts, we should add a short addendum: "Derived Artifact Distribution Grant" with provenance & attribution requirements.

Theo Wang: Ops/Eng-ML notes: preferred artifact list:
```
- model_id: cedarbridge-9b-open
- provided: fp16 weights (sha256), tokenizer.json, model-card.md
- optional: q4_0 artifacts (prefer)
- container: OCI image + sha256
- perf: latency report (p95), sample_inputs.tar.gz
```
If CedarBridge can't supply q4_0, Eng-ML can convert but needs license rights to redistribute quant variants to Meridian. Also Meridian requires signed OCI bundles for on-prem appliances.

contract-bot: Precedent lookup: found templates "Derived Artifact Distribution Addendum v1" and "Marketplace Hosting + Geoblocking Addendum". Recommend including geofencing language if Meridian will do EU-only deployments. Links pushed to drive.

Ivy Tran: Partner asked for a 3-week launch window with SI validation in week 2. Meridian requests a 7-day validation window and then a 5-day embargo. That pushes announce to ~4 weeks if legal needs negotiation. Can Legal expedite?

Sana Mirza: I'll draft the narrow addendum (Derived Artifact + Geofence + Provenance) and circulate to CedarBridge counsel. If they accept distribution rights for quantized variants, we can keep the 3-week cadence. If not, fallback: hosted-only + SI works via API.

Noah Becker: I'll start the SKU mapping (Hosted / Dedicated / Private EU) and list of marketplace assets. Will add a fallback hosted-only flow in case redistribution is blocked.

Theo Wang: I'll allocate Eng-ML time for conversion/eval (48h) but mark it conditional on license. Also preparing OCI signing instructions for Meridian.

Ivy Tran: Responsibility summary: Partnerships = partner comms + launch cadence; Legal = addendum + export check; Eng-Platform/Noah = SKU + ingest pages; Eng-ML/Theo = quant + perf; Ops = OCI signing/KMS; SI/Meridian = validation. Reconvene TOM at 11am PT. Flag blockers here. :calendar:

Noah Becker: ack :thumbsup:

Sana Mirza: ack, will post draft addendum link in thread.

Theo Wang: ack, will post preliminary test harness link when ready.

Ivy Tran: Thanks team — keeping it tight. If CedarBridge counters on distribution rights, we'll decide whether to delay or proceed with hosted-only SI.
